Subject: Initial ask — MAP and acceptance tests for pilot

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for last week’s demo — the team was impressed with the throughput and the monitoring surface. Our product and procurement teams want a compact mutual action plan (MAP) and a clear list of acceptance tests we can run during a 4-week evaluation. Procurement asked for anything you can provide up front to make the legal/SOC2 review faster.

Key asks from our side:
- Short list of success criteria and exit gates (reliability, quality, security)
- A minimal checklist of acceptance tests we can run during the pilot (including sample traffic profile)
- Any SOC2/audit evidence you can share or a pointer to how you enable audit logs in private deployments

I’ve attached the RFP summary for context (Medinet-RFP.pdf). Can you send over a one-page MAP and an evaluation timeline by EOD? Procurement is tentatively asking for kickoff week of Aug 10.

Thanks,

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Initial ask — MAP and acceptance tests for pilot

Elena — thanks for the RFP and the clear asks. I put together a concise MAP and a proposed set of acceptance tests (attached: MAP-v1.xlsx) and summarized the evaluation certification roadmap below. High level goal is to keep the evaluation light-touch while ensuring we cover the things procurement/legal will need.

Proposed exit gates (pass/fail checkpoints):
1) Operational stability — 7-day rolling 99th pct latency under 1s for target request profile OR sustained tail latency within agreed band for prod-like traffic.
2) Functional concordance — end-to-end task-level accuracy/concordance >= 92% on the agreed prompt set (we’ll run 1k prompts across the pilot).
3) Security & access controls — successful SOC2 evidence checklist items (audit log access, key management, VPC controls) verified by your security contact.
4) Cost/throughput fit — average inference cost per 1k tokens within agreed threshold; no unexplained cost spikes during test runs.

Acceptance test inventory (short):
- Load test (4-hour soak at expected QPS with burst windows)
- Regression check (50 curated prompts + 950 random probes -> concordance measurement)
- KV/prefix caching smoke (verify cache hit ratio and latency improvements)
- Security sanity (review access logs, KMS integration test, confirm data retention policy)

Suggested timeline (4-week pilot):
Week 0 (pre-kickoff): MAP sign-off, legal/procurement questions answered
Week 1: Install/connection, smoke tests, baseline metrics
Week 2: Load & regression tests; start evidence collection
Week 3: Stability run and corner-case probes; fix/iterate any config gaps
Week 4: Final acceptance sweep and handoff/close decision

Next steps: Ben / Marissa — can you pull together the SLA draft and a short FAQ for procurement? Elena — if that looks sensible, we’ll update the MAP and send MAP-v2 with attachments by midday.

Thanks,
Avery

Avery Johnson
Enterprise Solutions
